name: GhostSkeleton
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostSkeleton. Same as prop plus shape. Sets data-themed so recipes apply without a wrapper element (required for as=td). Hand-written because the wrapper is a .ts defineComponent.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSkeleton.

props.name: shape
props.description: Visual treatment. The default omits data-shape so CSS can treat a missing hook as a text line.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional. Leave empty. Slot content stays aria-hidden and inert with the root.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The element selected by as. data-themed attaches default recipes.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-surface-subtle-bg
cssProperties.description: Shimmer highlight mixed over the muted fill.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-duration-expressive
cssProperties.description: Shimmer period. Collapses under reduced motion.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-radius-sm
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the default text shape.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-radius-md
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the rect shape.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-type-size-md
cssProperties.description: Default block size of the text shape.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-min
cssProperties.description: Default size of the rect block size and the circle.

keyboard.Tab: Moves past the skeleton. The root is inert and is not a tab stop.
